title: Observe VSTest collector events without rewriting outcomes
goal: Observe real test-case events in a collector while preserving runner-owned identity, child-case flags and outcomes as event contracts become writable.

selectionNotes: The original draft reversed the change: all five setters become public. Preserve observation without rewriting runner identity, child flag, TestElement or outcome; no removed-setter migration is taught.
Actual real top-level start/end observations match TRX with collection enabled/disabled. Child=true/nested-framework transport and arbitrary ordering are not qualified.
Public constructors are separate unit fixtures. The assignment control is compile-only and never called on real runner events.
Only target11 is advertised; the actual net10 comparison adds no foundation or unverified newer-package down-level route. PIN-959/PIN-963 and Human gates remain open.
